description: Implementation of CustomerOptionValueService for managing customer option values, including methods for listing, saving, updating, deleting, and retrieving by code.

classes.name: CustomerOptionValueServiceImpl
classes.description: Service implementation class for managing customer option values, providing CRUD operations and associations handling.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of customer option values for a specific store and language.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new CustomerOptionValue or updates an existing one based on its ID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a CustomerOptionValue along with related CustomerAttributes and CustomerOptionSets.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a CustomerOptionValue by its code within a store.
